budget_review.decision: All prior identities remain charged and 24 proven historical screen identities were appended from immutable local artifacts. Legacy raw-row DSR code has been eliminated and all twelve historical paths are union-aligned or fail closed. The fixed 160-identity campaign budget was not raised. New return-hypothesis registration remains paused pending a formal budget decision.
budget_review.next_tripwire: No new return identity may be recorded until a formal review either closes the campaign at 162 identities or authorizes a prospective budget with documented rationale. Engineering, data-lineage, execution, publication, and exact reproduction work may continue.

definitions.immutable_execution_record: One append-only, config-hash-unique measurement row. Rolling-window remeasurements remain records.
definitions.hypothesis_identity: A distinct economic or parameter identity after removing only start and end measurement-window keys.
definitions.window_only_remeasurement: A later record whose config differs from an existing identity only in start or end. It remains public but does not inflate DSR selection N.
